user.title: Add a Channels device
user.description: Channels apps and DVR servers are normally found automatically. Enter one by hand only if it was not.

data_description.host: The IP address or host name of the TV or server.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default: 57000 for an app, 8089 for a server.

error.cannot_connect: It did not answer. A Channels app only answers while it is open and in front on its TV.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

data_description.sync_offset_ms: Positive values make this TV play later than the leader when syncing; negative values make it play earlier.

sync_playback.name: Sync playback
sync_playback.description: Puts follower TVs on the recording the leader is playing, at the leader's position.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: The Channels player to copy. It must be playing or paused on a recording.

followers.name: Followers
followers.description: The Channels players to bring in line with the leader.

follower_timeout.name: Follower timeout
follower_timeout.description: How long to wait for each follower's Channels app to answer.

tolerance_ms.name: Tolerance
tolerance_ms.description: How close to the leader a follower must end up to count as synced.

switch_to_recording.name: Switch to recording
switch_to_recording.description: Moves a TV that is on live TV onto the recording of the same programme, starting a recording if there is none.

entity_id.name: Players
entity_id.description: The Channels players to move onto a recording.

behind_live.name: Behind live
behind_live.description: How far behind the live edge to land.

seek_by.name: Seek by
seek_by.description: Seeks forwards or backwards by a number of seconds.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Seconds to seek; negative seeks backwards.

seek_forward.name: Seek forward
seek_forward.description: Seeks ahead by the amount set in the Channels app.

seek_backward.name: Seek backward
seek_backward.description: Seeks back by the amount set in the Channels app.
